edge_assumptions.backstop: occupied and non-actionable short gestures with immediate focus and zero HID-down observation
ack-before-threshold and threshold-before-ack with exact action, binding, session, and threshold reconciliation
release and every stale, failure, source, and session path must remain monotonic and HID-up
threshold equality, one-poll edge, and same-poll chord boundaries use explicit wrap-safe transitions
empty-first release/removal/reset/suspend/resume/reconnect lifecycle observations and all-keys-up rearm
all six ordered owner/other-key pairs, owner release, and no ownership transfer
exact deployment identity, descriptor stability, CDC/HID lifecycle, flashing, recovery, latency, and stuck-key rows
closed protocol and fixed-Space negative matrix reject generic action, key, macro, text, and provider authority
4096-byte-including-LF v2 envelope, overlong rejection, and next-valid-frame recovery
bounded CDC traffic during active HID, focus changes, lifecycle interruption, and seeded mixed stress
